notes: Candidate discovered by grid scan; this is not a published field-test site.
Best geometric match at 2400 m scale; thermal and aridity context from ERA5 climatology.

caveats: Geometric, not planetary, similarity index: relief geometry does not reproduce gravity, regolith, illumination or chemistry.
Radar roughness not available at both sites: it is not included in the index.

Thermal amplitude: compares diurnal swing (Earth: 2 m air, ERA5 climatology; target: Diviner/MCD surface temperature). It rewards Earth sites with larger swings; the quantities differ (gravity, atmosphere, surface vs air) and it does not claim physical equivalence.
Editorial prototype weights, not calibrated against real missions.

method.description: The displayed index is a terrain-comparison index (0–100), not planetary similarity. It compares only the available component metrics and renormalizes their displayed weights. Slope, relief and TRI use a 100 × smaller absolute value / larger absolute value component score with metric-specific floors. Radar roughness in dB uses an exponential difference score. Thermal amplitude, when present on both sides, uses a ratio score with a 1 K floor and compares Earth 2 m air climatology with planetary surface values; it is not physical equivalence.
limitations: A candidate generated by this grid is not a verified or published field-test site.
The comparison does not establish geological, material, operational, or planetary equivalence.
Missing values remain unknown and must not be interpreted as zero.
